snippet.title: Encroacher: Snakes Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
You are an Ape...Controlled by Snakes...on Mars!
Encroacher: Snakes is an upcoming snake-tossing cryptic adventure. Visuals that remind you of schooltime spent in computer lab. The snakes will not tolerate failure.

Wishlist on Steam!
